name: Fugro N.V.
summary: Fugro N.V., together with its subsidiaries, provides geo-data services for the infrastructure, energy, and water industries in Europe, Africa, the Americas, the Asia Pacific, the Middle East, and India. It offers marine site characterization solutions, including geophysical survey and geotechnical investigation solutions, as well as geo-consulting solutions, such as ground modeling and geohazard risk assessment services; and real-time monitoring and forecasting of weather, currents, and environmental conditions.
